import json, subprocess, sys
import kit

CLI = kit.CLI
ERROR = b'{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}\n'


def raw(data):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", CLI], input=data,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=200)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[:500])
    return proc.stdout


cases = [
    ("empty", b""),
    ("garbage", b"not json"),
    ("duplicate key", b'{"a": 1, "a": 2}'),
    ("nan", b'{"a": NaN}'),
    ("infinity", b'{"runs": [1, Infinity]}'),
    ("-infinity", b'{"runs": [-Infinity]}'),
    ("trailing", b'{"types": []} {"types": []}'),
    ("trailing comma", b'{"types": [],}'),
    ("bad utf8", b'{"types": "\xff\xfe"}'),
    ("scalar root", b'5'),
    ("array root", b'[1,2]'),
    ("null root", b'null'),
    ("string root", b'"hello"'),
    ("1e400", b'{"a": 1e400}'),
]
fail = 0
for label, data in cases:
    out = raw(data)
    ok = out == ERROR
    print(("pass " if ok else "FAIL ") + label, out[:60])
    fail += 0 if ok else 1

# 64 MiB + whitespace must be refused
big = b'{"types": []}' + b" " * (64 * 1024 * 1024 - 12) + b" x"
out = raw(big)
print(("pass " if out == ERROR else "FAIL ") + "oversize", out[:60])
fail += 0 if out == ERROR else 1

# a valid campaign at exactly the boundary shape still works
valid = json.dumps({"types": [], "modules": [], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                    "entries": [], "machine": None, "runs": []}).encode()
out = raw(valid)
print(("pass " if out == b'{"plans":[],"records":[],"corpus":[]}\n' else "FAIL ") +
      "valid", out[:60])
fail += 0 if out == b'{"plans":[],"records":[],"corpus":[]}\n' else 1
print("failures", fail)
PYEOF
